entities.name: Marath, Will of the Wild
entities.description: A legendary elemental beast who roams the untamed regions of a shaman-ruled plane; believed by elves to be the source of growth and natural justice.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Elves who share the wilds with Marath and believe he is the source of growth and natural justice.

events.summary: Where Marath passes, vines twine out of the earth, green mist forms animal shapes and new life is created.
events.quote: As he passes, vines twine out of the earth
